findings.reason: it changes which file gains the new function and which module the seven sites and the reset import from, so acting on it edits §14's mechanism rather than its substance.
findings.text: the section homes the shared prefix-clause renderer in `imas_codex/discovery/base/claims.py`, justified only by "the shared owner both modules already import", but `claims.py` owns claim-token coordination (stale-claim release, deadlock retry) and holds no query-fragment renderer, while the just-landed §19/§20 work established `imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py::render_chunk_source(alias, output)` as the owner of exactly this shape — an alias-parameterised Cypher fragment renderer; homing a second one in `claims.py` forks fragment rendering away from its owner, and the natural fix is to add the renderer beside `render_chunk_source` and have the seven sites and the reset import it from there

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §14 adds one shared clause renderer rather than a new module, and collapses seven inline copies instead of spreading new wrappers over the same machinery, so the change removes surface rather than adding it.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the shared prefix-clause renderer is homed in `imas_codex/discovery/base/claims.py`, but the repository's owner of alias-parameterised Cypher fragment rendering is `imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py` (`render_chunk_source(alias, output)`).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §14 adds no CLI option (it reuses the existing `--root` and `--reset-to`), no MCP view and no refusal family, and its own text names the seven inline predicates it merges into one shared renderer.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the only not-yet-implemented section (§14) cites the mechanisms it extends without rebuilding them: `reset_to_status` / `PATH_RESET_SPECS` with `extra_filter`/`extra_params` in `imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py` (already used by the signals command to scope a reset by scanner), the existing `--root` path-claim prefix predicate, and `claim_paths_for_expanding`'s `expanded_at IS NULL` gate; each was opened and confirmed, and the diagnosis "no writer clears `expanded_at`" holds (grep: only `frontier.py:1931` sets it, nothing nulls it).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the new helper is a de-duplication of a predicate that already exists at seven sites, not a thin layer over machinery; §14 extends `reset_to_status` through its existing `extra_filter` hook rather than wrapping it.
